t: One Great Tree fell, the rest will follow! I foresaw it - like a spider's web, darkness fell on Sarnaut! Forget the trees, they can't help you anymore! It's the era of spiders!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Why or why must I wade in the mud over this mossy old rock?

This is a very ancient statue, much older than even the Benefactor's. The Immortals don't like this kind of talk, and it's not exactly topical, so the legend of the crocodile is only remembered by strange old men like my grandpa, may the grass be soft under his feet. The legend goes something like this. A long, long time ago, when the Ancients disappeared and the world sunk into darkness, the Tekyans lived in turmoil and poverty. One particularly bad year the Jumayo River dried up, and the Tekyans' laundry list of problems now included thirst. Now, that would have been the end of us, but then a benevolent crocodile god appeared. He struck the ground with his mighty tail, creating a spring bursting with pure and fresh water. The Tekyans praised the crocodile as their saviour and built this statue in his honor. And that's pretty much it...

You are not going to believe this, but a few months ago, something very strange happened. The edge of our island, which had remained intact for a thousand years, suddenly began to melt, like snow in warm water!

After everything started to fall apart here, I found this strange place with this unusual piece of ice! I wanted to study it, but the Urun came running... and I hid in a snowdrift. You saw the rest.

What is this?

...someone's bloodless body was thrown into the canal? Ghouls underwater?!
h: Tell her about the ghouls in the river and the promissory note

t: We are forced to be the rearguard of Hirkalla's army!

So you are interested in all sorts of eccentrics and renegades, ? The city is filled with odd people, and it's difficult to single out anyone in particular... Only part of the released Sparks returned here, and more are coming...

But fine. Recently I was told about a mysterious gambler who frequents a local gambling club but never plays himself. They say he wants to learn the secret winning combination! Of course, it does not exist...

But there is a legend that the Great Mage Elleken knew a certain secret of "three cards" which allowed him to win every time. But as you understand, these are just stories...
h: Do you know of any unusual cases?

t: Any news of the rebellious nobles in Kania?

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support

Bards can come up with a song on any occasion. The striking lyrics and a captivating tune sow discord within the enemy's ranks or encourage allies.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support, Healing

In combat, Wardens call upon the forces of nature. And they always travel with their pet, who is a loyal friend and a trained helper in combat.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support

Engineers never go anywhere without their best friend, the gun mount. They also use standalone combat devices, tricky traps and chemical or explosive mines.

Armor type: cloth

Aspect: Attack, Support

The Mage controls the elements. Ice and fire, thunder and lightning - they are ready to unleash it all on their enemies.

Armor type: cloth

Aspect: Attack, Support, Healing

Summoners are never met alone; undead minions are their faithful allies. They use dark magic to spread diseases amongst their enemies, poison them and corrode their armor and flesh with acid. The very same dark magic allows them to heal their group members.

Armor type: plate

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Paladins are holy champions of the Light. The formidable warriors of melee combat and reliable defenders for their allies, they wear shiny plate armor and use magical barriers to withstand the most powerful blows.

Armor type: plate

Aspect: Attack, Support, Healing

Healers are bulwarks of the Light. The powers in their control can cinder their enemies in an instant, or heal most severe wounds of their allies. The most experienced of them are able to fight from a distance as well as in a melee combat.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support

The Psionicist prefers fighting with their mind. With but a thought, they can make their victims scream and writhe in terror and pain as they twist every single bone in their bodies.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Scouts prefer to shoot their enchanted arrows from a distance, but they can easily switch to close combat, snaring their opponents or knocking them down. Versatile fighters who rely on quick reflexes, speed and agility, they provoke their enemy and dodge their blows, at the same time granting excellent protection for their group.

Armor type: cloth

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Demonologists are powerful mages who use demonic powers and occult knowledge to efficiently dispose of their enemies. Their secret knowledge allows them to assume forms of various demonic entities, each with their own advantages and drawbacks.

Armor type: plate

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Warriors are specialists of melee combat. All existing kinds of weapons serve them equally well when it comes to smashing their enemies into the ground.
What a nice vial of blood I see!
To die again?.. I should get rid of this bad habit.
The sooner you die, the faster I satisfy my thirst!
Hm... I suffer from ill premonitions...
I don't want to lose my head again...
Ha! Give my best regards to goblin!
Look who's here! Get up on the table!
I can't die right now! Not before the breakthrough!
I will be keeping you alive for a very, very long time...
Pipe my hands on deck, hah-hah!
I knew this trip would bring no luck!
I'll feed you to the fish!
Wimps from the surface have nothing to do in the mountains!
Come, sisters! May our leaders feast on the blood of our enemies!
Lightning bolts shall strike your defenseless flesh, wingless ones!
The power of the storm fills my heart with rage!
Freeze! You here to steal something?
The sanitarium is done for... Forgive me, Yasker, I have failed...
I'll throw you out into the frosty air... With nothing but underwear on, ha-ha!
In the name of the Queen!
Brothers... How can it be true?
Ah, more lunatics? Or they are sane? There can be only one decision - kill them!
Tep will happily accept your Soul!
It is Empire's land! Get out of here!
Heretics! I won't allow you to desecrate the Temple!
Holy Tensess, accept your loyal servant...
Agr-r-rh! It is your fault, slave!
We don’t have guests here often.
Make yourself comfortable, get used to the soil.
Those who attack the working class are always hit back!
Let's get to work! We have to rebuild everything from scratch!
Xadaganian workmen and red aviaks are brothers forever!
Be a dear - stand in the line of fire...
I haven't had my fill yet!
Maybe I should have mercy on you...? No, that's just nonsense!
One bullet for you, one for you...

Yes, it's a disaster. The forests are now filled with insane Treants, unusually overgrown plants, crystals, and Ambrosia streams that can harm travelers.

I suspect it's caused by the imprisonment of the Goddess of Nature in our world. Trapped by darkness, she spawns these... nightmares that break into the real world.

Nobody knows what to do with the shadow woods. They keep growing, absorbing more and more new territories.

Айденус и Яскер – два лидера государств в сложной ситуации. Они уже давно не контролируют происходящее в Сарнауте, и всё, что они могут сделать – это реагировать на новую угрозу. События на Джигране в очередной раз перевернули всё с ног на голову. И если для Айденуса возвращение Скракана - безусловное подспорье, то для Яскера – возвращение Незеба это опасный вызов и потенциальный кризис! Кто знает, не развернётся ли в Империи междуусобная борьба?

Впрочем, пока оба лидера контролируют происходящее. Все-таки они теперь не обязаны подчиняться Иркалле, которой пришлось убрать своих тёмных миньонов из столиц, да и общая угроза Тэпа пока работает на сплочение. Однако, кто знает, как дальше всё повернётся?

While the Elves do not have the same problems as the Gibberlings and Orcs, they also have reasons to be unhappy with the League. The war, and especially the war as it was on Dane, is very far from the ideals of Beauty and Pleasure. Irretrievable losses, when the dead did not even have a chance to be reborn, horrified the Elves. "The league was created for safety, but what did we get besides endless battles?" This is what the few supporters of isolation have been saying so far.

That is why the new ruler of the Elves Antoinette de Delice negotiated with Yasker about developing stronger peaceful relations. Yasker agreed with her initiatives and announced the beginning of a "policy of detente" accompanied by "new thinking" - meaning the understanding that the conflict between the League and the Empire can be resolved peacefully. A cultural exchange has been organized - the youth of the League can visit the allods of the Empire, and vice versa!
I see sand and blood! I see flames and lightning! I see gold and lies! Before moon rises three times, the liar will tell his stories! Trust him, and you will lose your head!
Are you sure you are ready to fight demons ?
Great! Let's fight the demon scum!

Hm, it means that I'm dead, all the same. I must admit it' not very pleasant. Last time I did not feel anything, now I feel... weakened.
I fancy if this state is caused by the artifacts we have found in the sealed crypt at ZIT... It is worth thinking about. It seems I died there, at ZIT...
I’ll distribute the beewax, and you will give them hooch - I’ve been clean and sober for a while, you see, I wouldn’t want to fly off the handle.
Aren’t they beautiful? Let me make an amulet out of them...
Code Green, rose-two-six. Another skunk tried to steal a card!

Though no one expected it, the demonic threat is back. The renegade imperial mage Gorluxor, who has joined the neutral faction of the Historians, has made an attempt to claim the Gift of Tensess. Demon cultists and the demons themselves came to the Holy Land with him. It was a miracle we managed to stop them. Gorluxor was killed in the Tensess Temple, seemingly for the last time, with no chance of resurrection.

"The Great Astral Campaign is not over! The demonic threat has not been eradicated. You started celebrating too soon! The enemy is hiding and preparing to strike again," said Tensess's Soul to the heads of the state.

After seeing the evidence of the return of the demons, the League and the Empire realized that their old enemy was by no means defeated. On the contrary, he had been planning another attack for years. And while many allods were saved this time, the world still remained in mortal danger. The demons and their cultists needed to be defeated before they destroyed Sarnaut.

Realizing that the League and the Empire alone cannot hope to defeat their common enemy, the Veterans of the Great Astral Campaign united in secret, creating the "United Army", an alliance of the Empire and the League.

There was also the City of Demons. The League and the Empire kept trying to get there, but it wasn't easy. Something unexpected was waiting for the heroes in battle against Gorluxor. He wasn't alone - the room he was standing in was filled with capsules. And each capsule had Gorluxor in it. He himself had also changed considerably - from under the hem of his mantle, tentacles were visible instead of human legs. Behind him stood a strange apparatus - a device that allowed the cultists to come to life without the Gift of Tensess.

But after that device was destroyed, something amazing happened - Gorluxor's Tower shook and moved. It's like it disappeared into the ground. Alarmed, the heroes stepped closer to the pit.

As they descended into the Abyss, the heroes met a strange old man who looked more comical than threatening. And when the heroes defeated him, something incredible happened - the old man split into two parts - one was unthinkably beautiful, and the other was disgustingly terrible. A beautiful angel and a disgusting spider, so big that it filled the entire Abyss with its body. It was a hard-won victory, but it was still unclear who was behind Gorluxor.

Tep, an Arisen from the Zem people, found a way to live forever by killing his own compatriots with a deadly plague and absorbing the power of their Sparks. The mightiest sorcerers joined their forces to repel the aggression of the Summoner and contaminated Tep with his own plague. Confined in his own Pyramid and sustained by his Sparks, the Summoner was doomed to thousands of years of dying and resurrecting again... His own genius condemned him to madness.

But several millennia later Tep Cultists found a way to release their master...

The forebodings turned out to be true. Soon Umoir was struck by a mysterious Leper that turned all living beings into corrupted creatures, and once thriving groves and meadows into gloomy wastelands. Later was discovered the demonic nature of the Leper, created by Queen Catherina, whose will had been enslaved by Sarn.

The spread of the Leper was barely stopped with the help of Klavdia, who appeared out of nowhere. Catherina hastily fit out a huge ship called Eclipse and rushed to the depths of the Astral to find and destroy one of the Seals keeping Sarn confined. The greatest heroes pursued her and battled Sarn with the power of incarnated Nezeb and Skrakan - the Great Mages of the past. Catherina was released from the deleterious power of the God of Light. Then the Sarn's Avatar, which was hiding in the Ancient Mound, was destroyed, and the history of Leper on Umoir was finally put to an end.

Still the enormous power that Klavdia had stolen from Tep bothered the Great Mages of the League and the Empire. It was clear that it was nearly as great as that of the Gods. But what could Klavdia do with it? And where had Tep found a source of divine power? If it is not located, the next strike can be lethal for Sarnaut...

Events that year began with a distress signal received from the Imperial research ship, the Infinity. It was sent by Cosmos to study the deep layers of the astral plane. After summoning the Hero of Sarnaut, Cosmos asked him to find out what happened.

As it turned out, the Infinity discovered one of the Seals of Nihaz and was exposed to darkness that killed the entire crew. It turned out that Nihaz managed to create a new subspecies of demons - demons of Darkness who can influence the very Spark of creatures.

These demons were about to become a serious threat to Sarnaut, but then Zayan proposed a plan: to create an army of undead that would not possess the Sparks and therefore would be immune to such influences. At Catherina's suggestion, Foul Dale on Umoir was chosen as the gathering place for this army. And Klavdia Kalugina proposed to strike with this army at Nihaz and whatever he hides behind this Seal.

To create the army of the undead, a talented warlock was needed - it was Dakkar de Desirae. In addition, one of Urd's scrolls was discovered in Dale. Urd was an ancient Xadaganian summoner who possessed knowledge that greatly aided the creation of such an army. In addition, they managed to conclude an alliance with vampires, exiles from the House de Doucer, and subdue the ghosts of Gipat.

On Gipat, Dakkar and the Hero of Sarnaut found a very important testimony about the past of Nihaz and Klavdia Kalugina: "One day a very eloquent Traveler visited the court of the Mother and Father. The traveler confused many people, and Klavdia's sister was one of them. Those events started the Great War."

So far, it was difficult to interpret this data. After putting heroes of the past (Danas, Naira, Fergard, Reniesta, and Gorislav Averchenko) at the head of the army of undead generals, Dakkar and Nyan were able to restore Annette de Tristesse's mind - a vampire who also joined their army, becoming the commander of all vampires.

They also needed to get the Key to the Seal. It was obtained with Klavdia's help: she took the Hero of Sarnaut to the island Heart of Fire where the dragons kept the Key of Chaos. They got the key, but it turned out that Agrus and the other dragons were building an army of Draconids. They intended to attack the League and Empire in the near future.

After the army of the undead was ready, they were loaded aboard the Eclipse which headed for the Seal. The resistance of the demons and Nihaz's servants was enormous, but none of them stood a chance against the undead who simply swept away all the barriers. The only problem for Sarnaut's heroes was Hedus-Avior-Mirach, the Void Dragon, torn apart by Nihaz and distorted by darkness. While the commanders were planning another attack, it gave everyone a brief respite.

Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her plan: her target was Nihaz's Citadel hidden behind the Seal. While the heroes and the undead attacked the bastions head-on, Klavdia was able to sneak into the lower levels where she found the coordinates of another world, the world of Klavdia's mother, a powerful deity capable of defeating Nihaz.

To reach her, Klavdia decided to build her own Star Gates – the Gates-3 project was started on Suslanger.

However, a new player intervened: a mysterious saboteur caused the "Incident" which led to the release of large amounts of a new resource - the Ambrosia. This saboteur also stole a key part of the Gates-3 project and disappeared.

Klavdia asked the heroes to resolve the situation - and they managed to learn something. They met a mysterious girl named Alice on Suslanger. Apparently she was behind the "Incident". However, Alice managed to fool everyone for a long time, and no one was able to figure out her true motives.

The Expeditions of the League and the Empire discovered a new race of Aoidoi which appeared from the Well of Souls after the deaths of Sarn and the Architect. Well of Souls was the concentration of the power of the two dead deities. A terrible explosion gave rise to a separate allod - Ammer. Time there went much faster at first, and a powerful astral storm protected it from outside threats. But when the storm abated, demons started appearing on the allod.

Their victim was Domina Aellona, one of the rulers of the Aoidoi, a member of the Council of Domini. Another Dominus - Kyros who fell in love with Aellona -was immortal. Learning about the possibility of resurrection thanks to the Gift of Tensess, Kyros wanted to resurrect Aellona - but all in vain. Then Kyros decided that universal immortality is a poison that destroys this world, and that it was necessary to destroy Purgatory and the Servant of Tensess.

He managed to get the support of another race from Ammer, the centaurs. Once upon a time, Kyros defeated their leader Citovras in a duel, and now the centaurs respected the warrior of the Aoidoi immensely. The mysterious Wanderer also took his side, revealing the Secret Paths to Kyros. These paths were guarded by a strange creature called Simargl who loved riddles.

Kyros was stopped at the last possible moment, when he was already fighting the Servant. Altered by darkness, the immortal Aoidos vanished.

After these events, the other Dominus handed over power over the Well of Souls to Klavdia, Zayan, and Catherina. They created their own Orders of Followers.

Soon a new Dominus appeared from the Well of Souls - Cosmos. He decided to hold Dionic Games. During the games, Cosmos showed everyone that Nihaz was ready to retaliate. Apparently, Nihaz was behind the Wanderer who helped Kyros.

Cosmos used the Observatory, a unique creation that had its own mind, to send the hero of Sarnaut first to the past, where he saved Skulnar the Fierce, and then to the future, where the hero managed to bring the Sculptor to the present right before the world was destroyed by Nihaz. Later the Sculptor became the chief Architect for all architects in Sarnaut.

Cosmos announced that Nihaz was ready to destroy Sarnaut - and the only chance for the League and Empire to unite, ending all wars. If the leaders of states refused to do this, then Cosmos threatened to erase them from history with the help of the Observatory. That was when the League and Empire signed a peace treaty.

Artifacts are a true marvel!

You can find them in the most dangerous corners of Sarnaut. In Deep Astral and Distortions, on battlefields and group adventures you will certainly loot some. If you are a gifted craftsman, you can even craft them yourself!

If an artifact doesn't look good enough for you, you can transform it on the Anvil of Artifacts. I will help you with that. But remember: you can only transform artifacts that you created yourself! The ones that you looted in adventures can be easily disassembled with tools, unless they are cursed, of course.
Here, take it. This is all equipment you need, adjusted to your size and level.

Glad to see you.

I'm a Relic Master. There are only two of us in Sarnaut.

As soon as the first Relic of the ancient heroes was discovered, it became clear that such artifacts can be transformed, and the demand for my crafting skills was increased. Everyone needs a craftsman who has a knack for all these swords and armor. I used to be a blacksmith, you know... But under the guidance of the Great Yasker I was reforged, so to say...

Well, what would you like to know about my job?

The Empire is well known for valuing its citizens. That's why only in the Empire can you meet the all of your important officials.
Absolutely anyone can visit Yasker's Tower and personally meet with the leader of the City Council, the Imperial Sentinels, the Orcs, or the Arisen. You can even meet Yasker himself! No official is above meeting with the citizens they serve!

It's not easy to find the Demon Hunters! They never stay long in one place. But we know from intelligence reports that a small expedition stopped on a recently discovered archipelago called the Dragon Ring. And if you want to earn the trust of the Hunters and get their equipment, find Rustle the Forester, Sofia Lozhkina, and Vasily Gurov in their camp.

The Keeper of Peace, who serves the Master in the Citadel on the Isle of Revelation, is ready to provide those who join the ranks of his army with items of their allies - the Wormfaces and Draconids. And the Equilibrium Keeper can be found on the Twilight Isle at the outpost of the Master's forces.

In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open world, the brave defenders of the Empire can take part in battles at special training grounds. Here, death means nothing, because everyone is resurrected by the Great Mages. And those who win can receive special rewards. You can learn more from the quartermasters of the respective skirmishes. You can find them on the second floor of Yasker’s Tower. Ernest Sechin will tell you about the Guild Dominion, Slap the Furious - about rating combats, and Yaskul Sekhet - about random skirmishes. In addition, you can also find merchants selling rare goods there, like trophies from the battlefields.

Sarang Gahidzha is the holder of a dubious record - he disassembled his own tomb into individual stones in one hour and seventeen minutes. He's located on the top floor of Yasker's Tower and is available to train all new disassemblers.

The Freeborn are a coalition of various minor races that have gathered in Pridonsk in the Dead Sea. The Empire turns a blind eye to their activities since they see no harm in it. However, evil tongues say that they are in cahoots with the drug mafia. And others say they are at feud with them. If you figure out what's actually going on, you can get rewards from Purk the Hasty and Grum the Thrifty.

Semer Khendjer is the Imperial Guild Master. He oversees the creation of guilds. Guilds are official organizations formed by citizens for the purpose of pursuing a common goal.
Membership in a guild is highly encouraged by the Empire - I'm sure you'll find the benefits are invaluable. You should visit him on the top floor of Yasker's Tower.

Runes are special items that are linked to the power of the Great Martyrs. They can increase your power when placed in your weapons and armor. Every citizen should meet with Master Semer Nemar for an in-depth tutorial about the use of runes. He can be found on the top floor of Yasker's Tower.

The Order of Compassion was founded under Yasker's orders in the year 972. The goal of the Order is to spread of the teachings of the Trinity Church and help Imperial citizens wherever they are found.
Its members are called the Servants of the Light, and they consist of both courageous Xadaganian girls and the wise women of the Arisen. They sell drops of mirra which will aid you greatly in your travels.

Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical. Progress does not stand still! There is always something new coming out. Vladimir Kostin, an experienced horse breeder, can tell you all about them. He is well versed in technology - he can tell you about assault shells, for example. You can find him in Victory Park.

So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new kind of equipment - regular quartermasters can't help you anymore. You can get it from Naia Windina who can be found in the Astral Academy next to the forge. It's not the best possible equipment, but it should do for a start. Naia will give you a full set of items, and you can change their stats using special insignias.

Do you think you might make a decent agitator? Your skills will not go to waste, because the Free Traders, with Yasker's permission, have launched a special program to get new heroes to participate in adventures in our world.  And you can help them. You can find out the details from Angelika Berezkina, a representative of the Tycoons. She can be found near the bank in Yasker's Tower.

The oracle Sarbaz Segret can be found outside of Yasker's Tower. If you don't know what you should do in life, or if you're afraid you'll miss something important in the future, then I would suggest you talk to him. His visions are invaluable.

After the events on Ammer, there are three Orders in our world - the Order of Progress, the Order of Creation, and the Order of Balance. By joining them, and gaining Order Prestige, you will be able to acquire special prizes that Caeda, the Order Quartermaster, can bestow on you. You can find her in the Astral Academy.

The postal service was created to ease communications between citizens of the Empire. Employees of the service, called postal workers, can be found anywhere. They are always ready to tell you everything you need to know about letters and packages, and to quickly deliver your correspondences.

As I said before, the Empire puts a lot of effort into uncovering the secrets of the world. Recently a Xadaganian named Mark Staritsyn was appointed the Keeper of Secrets.
It's his job to systematically research and solve these mysteries. All citizens that have information regarding any riddles, mysteries, secrets, or even gossip are instructed to report to him.
Every Imperial citizen can now build their own Astral ship after proving their loyalty to the Empire. To learn more about this you should visit the Astral Academy at the Nezebgrad Port to the north.

To the north of Nezebgrad there is a port where ships regularly travel through the Astral to other parts of the Empire. Recently, most of the Empire's efforts are focused on transporting Imperial soldiers to the Holy Land where a war is raging.

These days Crazystorm the Merciless holds the position of Commander of the Imperial Sentinels. He completely re-examined the goals of the Sentinels and redirected all of their activities. Their main goal is no longer to fight the Astral demons, but to combat the insidious actions of the League.

Portals are a quick and reliable way to move between different territories. Now, thanks to increased prosperity and recent developments in science and magic, portals have been set up across all parts of the Empire. To learn more speak with the Portal Keeper Roman Mishin who is located in the Bort Quarter.
And what makes you think I'll give you that? As if I were just going to sign some papers all of a sudden. Hmph... I thought the citizens of the Empire had a higher opinion of us.
Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new abilities serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new abilities serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!
No, I've ordered another cape! Be more attentive.
Great! Now you bring me the next headpiece on the list.

Ah, so you're here about the rune!
Yes, I do have one for you. Here, take this. Thanks for the delivery!

Greetings!

We Mercenaries are not just after easy money, we are disciplined and experienced warriors, that surpass the soldiers of the imperial army by a long shot. Why? It's simple - those who prefer to earn a living with the sword and not with the plow, but do not want to feel like a square peg in a round hole, join the Mercenaries. From the point of view of the law, we are private military subcontractors that follow a special regime. We serve the Empire, but that doesn't mean that we can't make a profit. So if you need reliable, trained warriors at a reasonable price - you won't find better than us!

You can hire one Mercenary, or five if you want. So, shall we start discussing the contract?
Demon damn it, exactly what I've been hiding from!
Love is the most beautiful feeling!
The thoughts you catch erupt into a gamut of emotions, the majority being fury, hatred and bloodlust.
Let's begin. I would pray for a miracle, but I would not know who to ask. We can only rely on ourselves, I guess.

Astral is the basis for everything. This is the source of any entity, primal substance in its pure form, creating and destroying things.
Astral is composed of differing layers, so far you are only familiarized with the first one. But there is also life in the faraway Astral corners.
Don't be like a blind man assured that the world is limited by the length of his stick. Throw away your stick and you will see the light.
Remember, you have a unique opportunity - you can discover all secrets of the Astral, step into its depths. But no one knows what awaits you there. One thing I'm sure of - the things that do not kill you make you stronger.

You have already found four Astral Crystals.
Imperial Jade is a gem of travelers. It will protect you on your way.
Citrine is a symbol of cunning. It will save you from enemy intrigues and cheating during your journeys.
Amethyst will calm your mind.
Agate will warn you of oncoming danger.
But it's not enough to go further. You need two more gems.
No traveler will survive without a bit of luck, that's why you need Turquoise gem.
Besides, you can't continue your journey without Malachite. This gem binds the entire universe to our world.
When you gather all keys, Astral Gateway will open.
In the deeper layers you will meet much more powerful enemies. Perhaps you will find there new keys allowing you to dive into deeper layers. Take your chance and fight against the strongest opponents.
This is a challenge, a great trial. Pass the test, and you will be glorified. Fail, and no one will remember you. Choose your destiny!

Oh you’ve made a nice tangle, haven’t you? Haven’t I warned you to choose sides carefully? So what are you going to do now?

Do you think defeating an evil god and obtaining the godly power is what it takes? Of course... NOT! All the force that you’ve got will never outpower the real thing!

No, the real thing to fear is not Sarn. He’s safely shackled, don’t thank me. What threatens your world, is dark, huge and deadly. Even I wouldn’t mess with it! But now I’ll just step back and enjoy the view! I love tragedy!
I’ve said enough. Bye for now, mortal! See you soon!

Freedom is my dream! I can see the day that my shackles will fall off, and I will rize! The world will lay in dust, and then it will be reborn! I will be avenged, and my enemies will pay for everything!

Noone can stop me! Decide now, what you want - eternal life or oblivion?
It’s your own choice, mortal. I will meet you again, and at the last instant of your life you will observe my power!
Gather up forces! Call in for everybody, whether they are good or evil, for what is coming, is a hundred times more dangerous!
Lovely stone! I'll give you a dozen of cobra fangs for it! You would not exchange it, would you? Then why did you show it? To tease me?
Son of the Wind have tricky things. I believe you outlander, I'll touch this stone.

Well, better than in that dreadful castle anyway. Sometimes all those Houses’ policies just get too old... But then I remember that I could have been still trapped in that coffin in the chapel, and then preparing for the Ball doesn’t feel so awful after all.

Dakkar has to try really hard to maintain his authority, and I am doing my best to help him with that. His reputation has suffered enough since he chose a non-elf as a life partner.

Oh, I'm not sure... I can't say... We fought for three days and captured the Watchtower. You should have seen the assault - it was legendary! And not a scratch on me... I was that lucky! But later that night, in the camp... Ignatius Chernov... He offered to take a walk...
There are other things besides war, you know! Just one kiss, oh... I swear it! A single kiss... And that was it... When dawn broke I couldn't get up. A veil of darkness hung before my eyes. What's wrong with me? Help me! Help... Oh...

quests: The Plague of the Wandering Island

t:
The adventures of Ath-Zak began here in Gipat. An ancient record called the "Cursed Lands" tells about his adventures in Gipat, Ignos, and Suslanger. I recommend that you read it. It's quite fascinating.
The story ends happily. Ath-Zak recovers his memory, finds his sweetheart, and together with Tka-Rik, the June Great Mage, he defeats the ancient Curse. You will find more detail in the book.

The Catacombs consist of three circles.
The outer circle is relatively safe. The central circle represents a moderate threat to adventurers, and the third circle is the most dangerous.
Remember, the Catacombs are ever-changing. You can't use the same route twice. Doors you opened once may suddenly lock. Walls are moving, portals swap their exits. Everything is so unstable...
Keep in mind that damage and healing effects of your abilities will be reduced!

Gee, you have found my Teddy! Thank you, thank you, I'm so glad!
I thought he'd left me forever, but he just lost the way, and now you've found him!
Your nose is cold, and you are cold, let me warm you a little bit!
You again. Alive and whole. A pity.
Apologies accepted. Come on, I fully understand your concerns. League's welfare comes first!
Hurry up! I cannot hold it forever.
Jungles? Hmm, why not? Not bad. Looks good, nice and green. So, shall we stick with the jungles, or take a look at some other options?

quests: Creator's Gift: So they created earth

t: The whiteness of pure snow, the impregnability of gray stony precipices, blinding sun that makes your eyes water, and frost that nibbles at your ears. Each to their own! Shall we stick with the snow, or change to something else?

quests: Creator's Gift: So they created earth

t: Phew! That was the most interesting job in my life! Can you believe it - we've created a whole allod with our own hands! Thank you for this possibility. If you need some assistance in the future, do not hesitate to call on us!

Hello! And who are you?

You’re looking for Ademar? Yes, he’s been here for a while. I look after him - feed him and everything, but nothing works.

His heart and soul are shrouded in sorrow ever since his daughter Annette went missing. I don’t know what to do, I’ve tried everything. There’s only one option left, but it’s not something I can do myself.

Are you a great hero? Will you help, then? Go to White Lake, speak with the Bird Oracle Gamayun. Do what it says, and you might be able to help Ademar.

You a like a child. Always pick up dirt. It’s good you’re not trying to put it in your mouth.

Everything in this land has become corrupted. Every little thing, humans, animals, trees and flowers, all turn into dread. We call this disease "Leper". Only gods know how to cure it. We’ve tried both fire and wizardry, all in vain. Even Catherina herself, the Queen of Umoir, is only able as much as to restrain it, not to turn it the other way round.

This is not a good time to visit this place...
Thank you! What would I have done without you? My mother and father will be so happy!
Get ready. Let’s start with someone simple, like Midnight Dweller, for example.
That didn’t even make you sweat! Alright, let’s try something more complicated.

I've never seen the wood of such a remarkable quality! I wish the trees like these grew all around.
Wait a minute... He-e-eh! As it usually is... A heap of remnants and five decent bows. Give them to our allies, I fear they will need them very soon.

Can you feel the spring coming? Forces of nature are awakening, blood pounding in your veins! Do you feel the urge to perform something outstanding? Heroic?
By order of Aidenus, everyone must be given an opportunity to perform heroic deeds - and to celebrate the victory, of course. Buy Victorious Banner of the League from Silantiy Vinegarov, equip it and go out the the battlefield. Fight the Imperial players and receive the proof of your deed for every defeated player. Defeat more enemies all over Sarnaut, and receive valuable reward!
And don't miss your chance to take part in barbecue contest! A hungry warrior cannot fight! If you eat well, you will defeat more enemies and receive more rewards! Don't you think so?
 Aidenus himself will take part in the celebrations. He will give a speech near his tower every hour. Come and listen! All the guests will receive greeting cards. And if you bring your Guest of Honor papers, they will be stamped to certify that you've witnessed the ceremony.

Greetings!

Now when the fire was ceased on the frontline, the League and the Empire have finally made a step towards understanding. In order to establish friendly relations, it was decided to arrange a joint resort at the Tropical Atoll.

Oh, it's the best place in the world! Sunlit beaches, sand and palms! Smoothies, contests, prizes and fireworks... You should travel there, you won't regret!

There is no better place in Sarnaut than this hospitable island. A friendly tribe of the Great Turtle welcomes both Imperial citizens and League subjects. There is no place for long-standing fights at the resort - there is only sun, water, sand and entertainment. Crab racing, pub marathon, race and swim along the seashore, slot machines - there's entertainment for every fancy! To go there, you just need to buy a ticket from me given you have reached level 20.
